description:
Turn a US street address into latitude and longitude, with the standardized address, ZIP, county and FIPS code, state and census tract, from the US Census Bureau geocoder. US street addresses only (with a house number).

$0.002 USDC per call over x402. Failed calls cost nothing. Call without `payment` to get a quote. The first 3 calls a day through this tool server are free (no wallet needed).

When to use: You have a US street address and need its coordinates or census details.
Use instead: weather_forecast takes the address directly if the weather is all you need.
Parameters: address: a US street address with a house number.
Returns: latitude and longitude, standardized address, ZIP, county, FIPS code, state and census tract. No match is refused free.

address.description: US street address, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500".

payment.description: Base64 x402 payment payload. Omit it to receive a quote; sign that and call again.

name: geocode_address
title: US address to coordinates
